self_conditional_modifiers_json.description: R5 The Law's Equilibrium: +240 Elemental Mastery for 12s after using an Elemental Skill.

source.note: 7.0 weapon, added 2026-08-08 from nanoka 6.7.54 beta data (neither Amber nor GO carry it yet). Base stats derived as init x levels['90'] + last ascension add, the same derivation validated to the cent against 15 existing seed files. Buffs baked at R5 (house convention: 4* at R5, 5* at R1).

en.flavor: A longbow crafted to preserve order. Its cold radiance perfectly emanates the ideals of absolute fairness and justice.

refinements.1: For 12s after the equipping character uses an Elemental Skill, their Elemental Mastery is increased by <r>120</r>.
refinements.2: For 12s after the equipping character uses an Elemental Skill, their Elemental Mastery is increased by <r>150</r>.
refinements.3: For 12s after the equipping character uses an Elemental Skill, their Elemental Mastery is increased by <r>180</r>.
refinements.4: For 12s after the equipping character uses an Elemental Skill, their Elemental Mastery is increased by <r>210</r>.
refinements.5: For 12s after the equipping character uses an Elemental Skill, their Elemental Mastery is increased by <r>240</r>.
